description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named SettingsScreen, which provides a UI for editing DOM selectors and settings for a web automation tool. It includes controls for setting selector strings, a URL, and auto-submit options, and interacts with application state through AppState. It also manages saving and resetting configurations.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a user interface for editing website login and DOM selector settings.

classes.name: _SettingsScreenState
classes.description: State class for SettingsScreen managing controllers, state, and UI logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers and loads initial values from AppState.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _onSave
methods.description: Saves current settings to AppState and persists them; shows confirmation SnackBar.

methods.name: _onResetToDefaults
methods.description: Resets input fields to default values without persisting.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the settings UI, including input fields, switches, and buttons.
